description: UNLOCK THE WHOLE CARD-GATED ANIMATION VOCABULARY FOR EVERY PLAYER. WHAT CHANGES: the per-player skill-card test 0x143eadbe0(player, skillId) is replaced by 'mov eax,1 ; ret', so every card reads as owned for every player. Two whole instructions are replaced (mov [rsp+8],rbx = 5 bytes, push rdi = 1 byte); nothing is left half-overwritten. WHY THIS FUNCTION: it reads the player's pitch-slot byte [player+0x2bd8], returns 0 if that byte is above 0x15, otherwise resolves the slot's skill object and does a plain bitset test (cmp edx,0x49 / mov eax,[obj+rax*4+0xc0] / shr / and 1) - up to 73 cards held as three dwords at +0xc0. Every one of its ~287 call sites is inside match::anime::action::* (Feint, Kick, the CTrap* variants, Tackle, Trap, Block, Sliding, Dribble, goal_keeper::*, Injury); no match::ai:: decision code and no menu/myClub code calls it. 26 sites assign an animation id outright ('test al,al / je / mov edi,<animId>') and ~21 more are chained AND-gates where several cards must all be owned, e.g. CTrapDistAnimeInfo/CTrapAnimeInfo::vf5 at 0x14404e290 needs cards 0x4 AND 0x10 AND 0x15 together before that first-touch variant can even apply. WHO IT AFFECTS: everyone on the pitch, both teams, human-controlled players and CPU players alike - the function takes no team argument and has no human/CPU test. It also makes the off-pitch case (slot > 0x15) answer true, which stock never does. DEMONSTRATED (a-emulated, this session, Unicorn on the pristine image, nothing written): running the game's own kick-ability selector 0x143ed7440 over 264 situations with this function forced to 0 and then to 1 changes its result, which is how we know the overlay reaches real code. The 'different animation id when the card is owned' result for the Feint selector 0x143fa5aa0 (12 of 71 request ids promote, e.g. 0x26->0x38, 0x50->0x4a, 0x5c->0x5a/0x5e/0x88/0x89) is carried over from the investigation pass, not re-run here. INFERRED (b-disassembly): the site counts and the class attribution. SIDE EFFECTS - READ THIS: the same bitmask also feeds the ACCURACY model, so this spec alone makes poor players execute like good ones. (1) In 0x143ed7440 three purely card-conditioned arms add +5/+7 to effective kick ability before the 0x143ed71d0 curve. Emulated here: in the 21 of 264 sampled situations where the +5 arm fires, ability 65 goes 62->67 effective, f 0.1533->0.2867, max angle error 19.05 deg -> 16.05 deg (about 1.2 m less lateral spread on a 20 m pass); at ability 85 it is 7.05 deg -> 4.05 deg. ALWAYS APPLY anime-kick-card-bonus-off.json WITH THIS, and anime-kick-card-bonus-off-plus6.json too, because forcing the test true also makes the mixed +6 arm's card half always true. (2) NOT NEUTRALISED BY ANY PACK: 22 further card tests inside the kick-miss builder 0x14401a900 and its five factor functions multiply float terms into the per-axis error and write the miss sign probability outright (0x144021ab3 stores 1.0f, 0x144021add stores 0.7f, against a 0.5 default). Their direction and magnitude are NOT established - this is the one real open risk in the whole plan. (3) It is indiscriminate and cannot be undone per player or per card, and the UI still shows the cards as unowned, so the app's data and the game's behaviour disagree. The per-player DATA route (write the skill bits into Player.bin) is the better ship; see the pack report. WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN ONE MATCH: take a deliberately low-flair player (an ordinary centre-half or a journeyman full-back) and try the flair feints and first-touch traps that normally only elite card-holders play - drag-backs, sombreros, lift traps, cushioned turns away from a marker. If the vocabulary is genuinely unlocked you will see him attempt animations you have never seen from him. Also watch a poor passer's 20-30 m balls: with the bonus-off packs applied they must still scatter (that is the point); if they suddenly zip in cleanly, the accuracy leak is not fully closed and you should fall back to the data route. Bytes at 0x143eadbe0 are identical in the PRISTINE backup and the installed image; a whole-image scan of every executable section found no relative branch (rel8, rel32, jcc rel32) landing inside 0x143eadbe1..0x143eadbe5. REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/anime-unlock-all.json

patches.name: SKILL_HAS 0x143eadbe0 -> mov eax,1 ; ret (two whole instructions replaced)
